# Catalyst by Zoho

Skills that teach agents to work with Catalyst by Zoho. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [catalystbyzoho/claude-plugin](https://github.com/catalystbyzoho/claude-plugin), at commit `9670b79`.

Official Claude Code plugin for Catalyst by Zoho — full-stack serverless cloud platform.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Catalyst by Zoho**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Catalyst by Zoho**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install catalyst-by-zoho@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

16 skills: `catalyst-appsail`, `catalyst-authentication`, `catalyst-basics`, `catalyst-by-zoho`, `catalyst-cache`, `catalyst-datastore`, `catalyst-functions`, `catalyst-nosql`, `catalyst-pricing`, `catalyst-sdk`, `catalyst-signals`, `catalyst-slate`, `catalyst-smartbrowz`, `catalyst-stratus`, `catalyst-zia`, `catalyst-zoho-mcp`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
